Converts a raster to another data type, byte, short, integer, float or double, keeping its novalues.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Raster, Conversion, Type, Integer, Float<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterConverter`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster to convert. |
| `pOutType` | String |  |  | The data type of the output: byte, short, integer, float or double. If not given, the type doesn't change. Allowed values: `BYTE`, `SHORT`, `INTEGER`, `FLOAT`, `DOUBLE`. |
| `pNorth` | Double |  |  | The north bound of the region to consider |
| `pSouth` | Double |  |  | The south bound of the region to consider |
| `pWest` | Double |  |  | The west bound of the region to consider |
| `pEast` | Double |  |  | The east bound of the region to consider |
| `pXres` | Double |  |  | The requested resolution in x. |
| `pYres` | Double |  |  | The requested resolution in y. |
| `pRows` | Integer |  |  | The rows of the region to consider |
| `pCols` | Integer |  |  | The cols of the region to consider |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The converted raster. |
